blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: When an LLM supplies an argument that a user could not readily construct, how can the user decide whether to accept its claim? Inspired by interactive proofs, we model human–LLM deliberation as an interaction between a prover with unrestricted internal search and a resource-bounded human verifier. The verifier requests and checks supporting details without access to the LLM’s internal state. Passed checks accumulate evidence toward an acceptance threshold. We prove anytime-valid soundness against adaptive provers: the probability of ever accepting a false claim is at most a chosen error level, provided the task supplies bounds on false passes and human checking errors that remain valid after every relevant history. A finite-horizon completeness bound additionally requires bounds on the adequacy of honest responses and sufficient diagnostic progress. Further checks can strengthen the evidence for acceptance, but each requires another adequate response and reliable human effort. Whether this tradeoff permits certification depends on the verifier’s effort budget, cognitive load, expertise, and fatigue. We identify conditions under which the supplied bounds certify a specified sequence of local checks but not a specified global check under the same resource budgets.
blocks.zh: 当一个LLM给出一个用户无法轻易构造的论点时,用户如何决定是否接受其主张? 在互动证据的启发下,我们把人-LLM审议作为一种互动,在无限制内部搜索的证明人和受资源约束的人类验证人之间进行。 核查人要求并检查支持性细节,而不访问LLM的内部状态. 通过检查后,证据累积到接受阈值。 我们证明随时对适应性证明人的正确性:接受虚假主张的概率最多只能是所选择的误差水平,只要任务提供虚假通行证的界限和在每一有关历史之后仍然有效的人检查错误。 有限范围的完整性还需要对诚实反应的充分性和充分的诊断性进展加以约束。 进一步检查可以加强接受的证据,但每项检查都需要另一种充分的反应和可靠的人力努力。 这种权衡是否允许认证取决于核查者的努力预算、认知负荷、专业知识和疲劳。 我们确定条件,根据这些条件,提供的范围可以证明当地检查的特定顺序,但不能证明同一资源预算下的具体全球检查。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: When an LLM supplies an argument that a user could not readily construct, the user still needs grounds for deciding whether to accept its claim. Our central question is whether that user can obtain such grounds through challenges within their own resource budget. Interactive proofs motivate a division of work between a powerful prover and a bounded verifier ( Goldwasser et al., 1989 ) : the prover supplies arguments or evidence, while the verifier selects and executes checks. We study the conditions under which this division supports reliable human–LLM deliberation.
blocks.zh: 当一个LLM提出一个用户无法轻易构造的论点时,用户仍然需要理由来决定是否接受其主张. 我们的中心问题是,该用户是否能够通过自身资源预算内的挑战获得这种理由。 交互证据激励着强大的证明人和受约束的核查人之间的分工(Goldwasser等人,1989年):证明人提供论据或证据,而核查人选择和执行检查. 我们研究这个分部支持可靠的人与LLM审议的条件.

blocks.en: The question arises in human–AI decision support, where predictions can inform consequential choices ( Kleinberg et al., 2018 ) and users receive performance information, explanations, or other assistance ( Lu et al., 2025 ; Lai and Tan, 2019 ; Lai et al., 2023 ) . LLMs extend this setting by producing arguments and responding to follow-up questions. Early work on GPT-4 documented broad capabilities across difficult tasks ( Bubeck et al., 2023 ) , while hallucination research identifies fabrication, contradiction, and unfaithfulness to source material or context ( Ji et al., 2023 ; Huang et al., 2025 ) . Prompt-only self-correction based on a model’s own feedback has not been robustly demonstrated on general tasks ( Kamoi et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 这个问题出现在人类—AI决定支持中,其中预测可以为相应的选择提供信息(Kleinberg等人,2018年),用户获得性能信息,解释或其他援助(Lu等人,2025年;Lai and Tan,2019年;Lai等人,2023年). LLMS通过提出论据和回答后续问题来扩展此设置. 关于GPT-4的早期工作记录了跨越困难任务的广泛能力(Bubeck等人,2023年),而幻觉研究则确定了对源材料或背景的捏造、矛盾和不忠(Ji等人,2023年;Huang等人,2025年)。 根据模型本身的反馈所作的即时自我纠正在一般任务上没有得到有力的证明(Kamoi等人,2024年)。

blocks.en: A user faced with an uncertain answer may ask the LLM to explain it. The explanation can make the output more inspectable ( Zhao et al., 2024 ) , but its plausibility and faithfulness are distinct ( Jacovi and Goldberg, 2020 ) . Self-explanations may fail to track answer generation ( Agarwal et al., 2024 ) , and chain-of-thought can omit biasing influences ( Turpin et al., 2023 ) . Optimizing plausibility may itself mislead users ( Jin et al., 2025 ) . The user therefore still needs to identify what in the explanation can be checked. Following the verifiability criterion of Fok and Weld (2024) , we focus on evidence about the claim’s consequences or a supporting derivation. Here, verifiability without transparency means certification without access to the LLM’s internal state or reconstruction of its generation process.
blocks.zh: 面临不确定答案的用户可能会要求LLM解释. 解释可以使产出更可检查(赵等人,2024年),但其可信度和忠诚度是截然不同的(Jacovi and Goldberg, 2020年). 自我解释可能无法跟踪答案生成(Agarwal等人,2024年),思维链可以省略偏差影响(Turpin等人,2023年). 优化合理性本身可能误导用户(Jin等人,2025年)。 因此,用户仍需确定解释中可检查的内容。 按照Fok和Weld的可核查标准(2024年),我们侧重于索赔后果的证据或佐证性推论。 在这里,没有透明度的可核查性意味着无法进入LLM的内部状态或重建其生成过程的认证.

blocks.en: The user need not request the entire supporting argument at once. Starting from a high-level argument, they can question a premise, request support for an inference, propose a counterexample, or ask for an executable test. The LLM supplies details in response, while the target claim remains fixed. Checking the requested details separately may make the review more manageable for a user with limited attention or domain expertise. Deliberation can expose competing arguments ( Fishkin, 2018 ; Mercier and Sperber, 2011 ) , and human–LLM deliberation and tool-interactive critique have shown benefits in some settings ( Ma et al., 2025 ; Madaan et al., 2023 ; Gou et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 用户无需同时请求整个支持参数. 从高层论证开始,他们可以质疑一个前提,请求支持一个推论,提出一个反例,或者要求一个可执行测试. LLM提供了详细情况作为答复,而目标索赔仍然固定不变。 单独检查所要求的细节可能会使审查对注意力或领域专门知识有限的用户更容易管理。 评议可以揭露相互竞争的论点(Fishkin,2018年;Mercier和Sperber,2011年),以及人-LLM评议和工具互动批评在一些场合显示出好处(Ma等人,2025年;Madaan等人,2023年;Gou等人,2024年)。

blocks.en: For example, an organizer reviewing a conference schedule can challenge the claim that it has no conflicts by checking selected speaker and room constraints against fixed records (Section 3.4 ). The organizer needs a challenge policy they can afford to select and execute, with a justified probability of exposing a conflict if one exists. Task structure, randomized audits, external checkers, formal verification, or suitable calibration may support this diagnostic guarantee. We take the policy and its checking guarantees as inputs and analyze how the resulting checks support an acceptance decision; constructing them remains a task-specific requirement. Clarification can guide later questions, with diagnostic checks supplying the certification evidence.
blocks.zh: 例如,审查会议时间表的组织者可以通过检查选定的发言者和会议室对固定记录的限制(第3.4节),对它没有冲突的说法提出质疑。 组织者需要一项他们可以选择和执行的挑战政策,如果存在冲突,则有揭露冲突的合理可能性。 任务结构,随机审计,外部检查,正式核实,或适当的校准,可能支持这种诊断保证. 我们把政策及其检查保证作为投入,并分析由此产生的检查如何支持接受决定;构建这些政策仍然是一项具体的任务要求。 澄清可以指导以后的问题,由诊断检查提供认证证据。

blocks.en: We formalize this setting with an LLM prover whose internal search is unrestricted and a resource-bounded verifier. Our model allows the LLM to give inadequate responses and the human to make checking errors. Adequate honest responses and correctly executed checks recover the ideal case. This separates the computational division of work from the cognitive burden of carrying it out: even a computationally efficient check may exceed a particular person’s attention, knowledge, or effort budget.
blocks.zh: 我们用LLM验证器使这一设置正式化,其内部搜索不受限制,并有资源限制的验证器. 我们的模型允许LLM做出不充分的反应,而人类则会做出检查错误. 充分诚实的回应和正确执行的检查 恢复了理想的情况。 这把工作的计算分工与进行这项工作的认知负担区分开来:即使计算效率的检查也可能超过特定个人的注意力、知识或努力预算。

blocks.en: We make three contributions: 1. We specify a finite-horizon challenge–response protocol for a fixed claim, including verifier-directed requests for evidence, a certificate-based acceptance rule, and conservative rejection when the verification budget is exhausted. The verifier can adapt questions and request details as needed. 2. We prove conditional certification guarantees: anytime-valid soundness against adaptive provers and finite-horizon completeness under response and execution reliability bounds, without requiring independent rounds. We retain a diagnostic guarantee during adaptive follow-ups by reserving a chosen probability for reference checks. Instantiations meeting the additional requirements of Corollary 9 yield interactive proofs. 3. We identify which review lengths meet both certification targets within the verifier’s resources (Section 5 ). This certifiable effective region depends on effort, cognitive load, expertise, and fatigue. Proposition 15 identifies when the supplied bounds certify a specified decomposed review but not a specified global checker under common resource constraints and separately justified diagnostic bounds. The thresholds show how much cognitive load must fall to compensate for splitting effort across rounds and relying on repeated adequate responses and correct checks.
blocks.zh: 我们作出三项贡献: 1. 我们规定了对固定索赔的有限范围质疑 -- -- 答复协议,包括核查人提出的证据要求、基于证书的接受规则,以及在核查预算用尽时保守拒绝。 核查人员可视需要修改问题和要求细节。 2. 我们证明有条件的认证保证:在答复和执行可靠性的限度下,随时对适应性证明人和有限范围完整性作出有效的证明,而不需要独立的一轮。 我们保留了在适应性跟踪过程中的诊断性保证,为此保留了选择的查询概率。 满足Comrollary 9额外要求的证据产生互动证据。 3. 我们确定在核查人的资源范围内,哪些审查长度达到两个核证指标(第5节)。 这个可认证的有效区域取决于努力、认知负荷、专门知识和疲劳。 提案15指出,在共同资源限制和单独说明理由的诊断界限下,提供的范围何时证明特定的分解审查,而不是指定的全球检查器。 阈值表明,为了补偿分散工作,依靠重复的充分反应和正确的检查,认知负荷必须下降多少。

The verifier can adapt questions and request details as needed.

blocks.en: The LLM-only simulations test whether answers accepted without revision are more accurate than the rest; they do not validate the human-verifier assumptions. Appendix C treats the separate privacy question: under the simulation and prefix-consistency assumptions stated there, stopping at the certificate threshold preserves honest-verifier zero knowledge.
blocks.zh: 仅LLM的模拟测试未经修改而接受的答案是否比其他的更准确;它们并不验证人验证人的假设. 附 录 C处理单独的隐私问题:在其中所述的模拟和前缀一致性假设下,停止在证书阈值上保留诚实验证者零知识.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: A human reviewing an LLM’s answer must decide what evidence to request and when it is enough to accept the claim. Related work offers several ways to organize this interaction and quantify its reliability. We compare how these approaches allocate verification work, which errors their guarantees control, and what they require of the evaluator.
blocks.zh: 一个人审查LLM的答复,必须决定要求什么证据以及何时足以接受索赔。 相关工作提供了组织这种互动和量化其可靠性的几种方式。 我们比较了这些方法如何分配核查工作、哪些方法错误了对保证的控制以及它们对评估人员的要求。

blocks.en: 2.1 Interactive Proofs and Machine Prover–Verifier Systems
blocks.zh: 2.1 交互式验证和机器验证系统

blocks.en: Interactive proofs motivate our central abstraction: a powerful prover makes a claim, while a weaker verifier interrogates it before deciding whether to accept. Classical theory formalizes this division through completeness and soundness ( Goldwasser et al., 1989 ) . For a human verifier, even a prescribed check may be executed incorrectly. Our model separates this source of error from the prover’s failure to supply an adequate response.
blocks.zh: 互动证据激发了我们的中央抽象:一个强大的证明人提出权利要求,而一个较弱的核查人则在决定是否接受之前询问它. 古典理论通过完整性和健全性使这种划分正式化(Goldwasser等人,1989年)。 对人类核查员来说,即使是规定的检查也可能是不正确的执行. 我们的模型将这一错误来源与证明人未能提供充分答复分开。

blocks.en: Several approaches train models to make their outputs easier to verify. Prover–Verifier Games learn checkable answers through a game between prover and verifier ( Anil et al., 2022 ) ; neural interactive proofs relate approximate verifier-leading Stackelberg equilibria to valid proof systems ( Hammond and Adam-Day, 2025 ) . Prover–verifier training also evaluates whether weaker model verifiers and time-constrained human raters can check the resulting answers ( Kirchner et al., 2024 ) . Self-Proving Models are closer to our setting after an answer has been produced: a manually specified verifier interactively checks an input–output pair ( Amit et al., 2025 ) . Their framework separates worst-case verifier soundness from the model’s ability to produce accepted proofs under an input distribution. We likewise distinguish false acceptance from successful verification of true claims.
blocks.zh: 有几种方法培训模式,使其产出更容易核实。 Prover–Verifer Games通过验证者与验证者之间的游戏学习可核查的答案(Anil等人,2022年);神经交互证明将大约验证者-领导 Stackelberg equilibria 关联到有效的验证系统(Hammond and Adam-Day,2025年). 验证员培训还评估较弱的模型验证员和受时间限制的人评分员是否能够检查结果的答案(Kirchner等人,2024年)。 自我证明模型在生成一个答案后更接近于我们的设定:一个手动指定的验证器交互检查一个输入-输出对(Amit等人,2025年)。 它们的框架将最坏情况核查员的可靠性与模型在输入分配下产生公认证据的能力区分开来。 同样,我们也把虚假接受与成功核实真实主张区分开来。

blocks.en: Zero knowledge imposes a separate requirement: an efficient simulator must reproduce the verifier’s view without access to the prover’s private information. Appendix C gives a conditional preservation result under stopping. It assumes a simulator for the full continuation interaction and agreement between its stopped prefix and the actual protocol.
blocks.zh: 零知识提出了单独的要求:一个高效的模拟器必须复制核查者的观点,而不能获取验证者的私人信息。 附 录 C在停止时给出有条件的保存结果. 它假设一个模拟器,用于其停止的前缀与实际协议之间的完全持续互动和协议.

blocks.en: 2.2 Scalable Oversight and Single-Advocate Protocols
blocks.zh: 2.2 可扩展监督和单一辩护协议

blocks.en: Some oversight proposals use evaluation to construct training signals. Iterated amplification uses decomposition to construct a training target ( Christiano et al., 2018 ) , while weak-to-strong supervision trains a stronger model on labels supplied by weaker models ( Burns et al., 2024 ) . We consider the subsequent decision faced by a human reviewing an answer from a fixed model.
blocks.zh: 一些监督建议利用评价构建培训信号. 迭代增殖使用分解来构建训练目标(Christiano等人,2018年),而弱到强的监管则在较弱的模型提供的标签上训练更强的模型(Burns等人,2024年). 我们认为,一个审查人随后面临的决定是一个固定模式的答案。

blocks.en: Consultancy closely matches this interaction: a single advocate answers a weaker judge’s follow-up questions. Studies compare it with debate, where two competing agents present arguments to a judge ( Irving et al., 2018 ) , using both human judges ( Michael et al., 2023 ) and LLM judges ( Kenton et al., 2024 ) . When advocates are assigned correct or incorrect positions, debate is more robust to incorrect advocacy across the tasks studied by Kenton et al. (2024) . Other experiments test whether stronger debaters help judges identify truth when relevant information is withheld ( Khan et al., 2024 ) , or whether people can use an unreliable model to solve tasks that neither can reliably solve alone ( Bowman and others, 2022 ) . These studies make the advocate’s influence on the judge a central concern for verification.
blocks.zh: 咨询与这种互动密切匹配: 一个律师回答一个弱法官的后续问题。 研究将其与辩论作比较,两名竞争代理人向一名法官(Irving等人,2018年)提出论据,同时使用人类法官(Michael等人,2023年)和LLM法官(Kenton等人,2024年). 当辩护人被分配到正确或不正确的立场时,辩论对肯顿等人(2024年)所研究的任务的不正确主张更为有力. 其他实验测试当相关信息被扣时,更强大的辩论者是否帮助法官识别真相(Khan等人,2024年),或者人们是否可以使用不可靠的模型来解决既无法可靠单独解决的任务(Bowman等人,2022年). 这些研究使律师对法官的影响成为核查的中心问题。

blocks.en: Formal oversight protocols obtain guarantees from assumptions about the computation being checked. Doubly-efficient debate gives protocols for verifying stochastic agents ( Brown-Cohen et al., 2024 ) ; Chen et al. (2026) construct interactive proofs and arguments for oracle-aided computations under robustness or low-degree-oracle assumptions. Our analysis instead takes task-specific diagnostic and execution bounds as inputs. Because the advocate can shape later questions, these bounds must remain valid after every relevant history. Section 7.2 and Appendix D give one way to preserve a diagnostic bound: mix adaptive follow-ups with reference checks whose detection probability is justified against every admissible prover. The mixing probability is chosen before each round, and the bound applies to the resulting policy under correct execution.
blocks.zh: 正式的监督协议从对计算进行核查的假设中获得保证。 Doubly高效的辩论给出了用于验证斯图克剂的协议(Brown-Cohen等人,2024年);Chen等人(2026年)在强性或低度-甲骨文假设下为甲骨文辅助计算构建了交互证据和论据. 相反,我们的分析将针对具体任务的诊断和执行范围作为投入。 由于倡导者可以塑造以后的问题,这些界限必须在每一个相关的历史之后仍然有效. 第7.2节和附录 D给出一种方法来保持诊断约束:将适应性后续与证明人检查相结合,证明每个可接受证明人的检测概率是合理的。 混合概率在每一回合之前选定,约束适用于正确执行的结果政策。

blocks.en: 2.3 Local Checking and Sequential Certification
blocks.zh: 2.3 本地检查和序列认证

blocks.en: Before a transcript can supply statistical evidence, the task needs concrete claims and check outcomes. Argumentation frameworks organize attacks, inference rules, and public commitments ( Dung, 1995 ; Modgil and Prakken, 2014 ; Prakken, 2005 ) . FActScore evaluates atomic factual precision against a knowledge source ( Min et al., 2023 ) , while ProgramFC composes local results through an executable fact-checking program ( Pan et al., 2023 ) . Draft, Sketch, and Prove completes formal proof sketches in Isabelle; a successfully checked proof certifies the formalized theorem, while correspondence to the original informal claim remains a separate issue ( Jiang et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 在记录稿能够提供统计证据之前,任务需要具体的索赔和检查结果。 辩论框架组织攻击、推论规则和公共承诺(Dung,1995年;Modgil和Prakkken,2014年;Prakkken,2005年)。 FActScore对照知识来源评价原子事实精确性(Min等人,2023年),而ProgrammeFC则通过可执行的事实检查程序来编集本地结果(Pan等人,2023年). Fraft, Sketch, and Prove在伊莎贝尔完成了正式的证明草图;成功检查的证据验证了正式的定理,而与原始的非正式主张的对应仍然是另一个问题(Jiang等人,2023年).

blocks.en: A correctly executed check may still miss an error. Combining a bound on that event with a bound on incorrect human execution gives our per-round false-pass bound. Test supermartingales and e-processes provide the established machinery for accumulating such evidence under adaptive collection and optional stopping ( Shafer et al., 2011 ; Ramdas et al., 2023 ) . Our soundness proof applies this construction and Ville’s inequality to the conditional bounds. Completeness also needs adequate honest responses and enough diagnostic progress before timeout; average checker accuracy does not supply these conditions.
blocks.zh: 正确执行的检查可能仍然错过错误 。 将这一事件的束缚与不正确处决的束缚结合起来,就等于我们每个回合的假通道。 测试超模拟和电子过程提供了在适应性收集和可选停止下积累此类证据的既定机制(Shafer等人,2011年;Ramdas等人,2023年)。 我们的正确性证明将这一构思和维尔的不平等应用于有条件的界限。 完整性还需要在超时前作出充分的诚实反应并取得足够的诊断进展;平均检查器准确性不能提供这些条件.

blocks.en: Recent AI verification methods use sequential testing for related decisions. E-valuator monitors agent trajectories using black-box verifier scores, with a density-ratio construction and PAC calibration of decision thresholds ( Sadhuka et al., 2025 ) . It controls the probability of falsely flagging a successful trajectory as unsuccessful. Cho and Sun (2026) accumulate evidence calibrated against a conservative failure reference pool to control release on workflow-infeasible tasks and analyze finite-horizon release power. Their null concerns the workflow’s ability to produce a reliable solution. We test the falsity of a fixed claim, with local bounds required to hold for every admissible adaptive prover.
blocks.zh: 最近AI的核查方法对有关决定采用顺序测试. 电子评价员使用黑箱核查分数监测代理轨迹,其密度-比例构建和PAC校准决定阈值(Sadhuka等人,2025年)。 它控制了将成功的轨迹误标为失败的可能性。 Cho和Sun(2026年)针对保守的故障参考集合积累了证据校准,以控制工作流程不可行任务的释放,并分析有限视距释放功率. 他们的无效之处在于工作流程能否产生可靠的解决方案。 我们检验一个固定索赔的虚假性,要求每个可接受的适应性证明人持有当地界限。

blocks.en: 2.4 Learned Verification, Self-Correction, and Selective Prediction
blocks.zh: 2.4 核查、自我更正和选择性预测

blocks.en: Verifier feedback can help select an answer or revise it before acceptance. Outcome verifiers rank candidate mathematical solutions ( Cobbe et al., 2021 ) , while process supervision evaluates intermediate steps ( Lightman et al., 2024 ) . LLM-as-judge systems use another model to assess completed outputs; agreement with human preferences coexists with position, verbosity, and self-enhancement biases ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) . Chain-of-Verification uses model-generated questions to guide revision ( Dhuliawala et al., 2024 ) , although prompted self-correction remains unreliable without external feedback across broader evaluations ( Kamoi et al., 2024 ) . Our certificate can use a model-generated score or critique only through a prescribed check with a justified conditional false-pass bound.
blocks.zh: 验证反馈可以帮助在接受前选择一个答案或修改. 结果验证者对候选数学解决方案进行排名(Cobbe等人,2021年),而过程监督则评价中间步骤(Lightman等人,2024年). LLM-as-judges系统使用另一个模型来评估完成的产出;与人类偏好的协议与位置,动词,自我增强的偏差共存(郑等人,2023年). 核查链使用模型产生的问题来指导修订工作(Dhuliawala等人,2024年),尽管没有更广泛的评价的外部反馈,促使自我纠正仍然不可靠(Kamoi等人,2024年)。 我们的证书只能使用模型生成的分数或批评,只能通过有正当理由的有条件的假通道绑定的指定检查.

blocks.en: Our protocol and simulations build on Prover–Verifier Deliberation (PVD) ( Sedoc et al., 2026 ) . Frozen LLMs exchange challenges and responses, allowing acceptance, rejection, answer revision, and retries; a challenge-first variant requires a challenge before acceptance. PVD labels an attempt Accept + No Change (ANC) when the verifier accepts and the prover has not changed its answer. In our formal protocol, the prover can supply further explanations and evidence, but the statement being checked remains unchanged throughout the run. Acceptance requires the accumulated evidence to reach a prescribed threshold. The simulations reuse ANC to examine whether stable acceptance is associated with correctness. They do not implement the certificate rule or establish the Effective Verifier assumption for human deployment.
blocks.zh: 我们的规程和模拟建立在Prover-Veriter Delection(PVD)(Sedoc等人,2026年)的基础上。 冻结的LLMS交换了质疑和回应,允许接受,拒绝,回答修改和重复;挑战-第一个变体在接受之前需要质疑. PVD 标记一个尝试接受 + 不改变 (ANC) 当验证者接受并且证明者没有改变答案时. 在我们的正式协议中,证明人可以提供进一步的解释和证据,但正在检查的陈述在整个运行过程中保持不变。 接受要求累积的证据达到规定的阈值。 模拟再利用ANC来检查稳定接受是否与正确性相关. 它们不执行证书规则,也不为人的部署确立有效的验证假设。

blocks.en: Viewing ANC as a rule for selecting answers connects these simulations to selective classification. A selective classifier either returns its predicted label or abstains: coverage is the fraction of cases on which it predicts, and selective risk is the error rate among those predictions. Geifman and El-Yaniv (2017) use labeled samples to choose a confidence threshold and bound this error rate, with high probability, for new cases from the same distribution. A dialogue-based selection rule could likewise be evaluated on independent labeled tasks. Our soundness guarantee addresses a different question: for any given false claim, how likely is the verifier to accept it? The bound must hold against every admissible adaptive prover under the stated diagnostic and execution conditions.
blocks.zh: 将ANC视为选择答案的规则,将这些模拟与选择性分类联系起来. 有选择的分类者要么返回其预测的标签,要么弃权:覆盖面是预测的病例的一小部分,有选择的风险是这些预测中的误差率. Geifman和El-Yaniv(2017年)使用标签标注的样本来选择一个置信阈值,并将这个误差率捆绑起来,概率很高,用于同一分布的新病例. 同样,也可以对独立标注的任务评价基于对话的选择规则。 我们的健全性保证涉及一个不同的问题:对于任何给定的虚假主张,核查者是否有可能接受它? 在规定的诊断和执行条件下,约束必须反对每一个可接受的适应性证明人。

blocks.en: 2.5 Human Checkability and Bounded Certification
blocks.zh: 2.5 人的可核查性和受约束的认证

blocks.en: A check that is informative in principle may still be difficult for a person to carry out. Human-centered studies examine this problem through the assistance given to the evaluator. An LLM-based deliberation interface improved appropriate reliance and performance in an exploratory graduate-admissions task ( Ma et al., 2025 ) , while cognitive forcing reduced overreliance more effectively than explanations alone ( Buçinca et al., 2021 ) . In fact-checking, explanations can improve efficiency yet induce overreliance when convincingly wrong ( Si et al., 2024 ) . Receiver ability, attention, motivation, and effort also constrain costly communication ( Dewatripont and Tirole, 2005 ) . These findings motivate allowing execution reliability to vary with the person and the review conditions.
blocks.zh: 原则上资料丰富的检查可能仍然难以进行。 以人为中心的研究通过向评估者提供的协助来研究这一问题。 以LLM为基础的审议接口在探索性的研究生入学任务(Ma等人,2025年)中改进了适当的依赖和业绩,而认知强迫比解释本身更有效减少过度依赖(Buçinca等人,2021年)。 在核实事实时,解释可以提高效率,但当令人信服地错误时却会引起过度依赖(Si等人,2024年)。 接收者的能力、注意力、动机和努力也制约着昂贵的通信(Dewatripont和Tirole,2005年)。 这些调查结果促使执行的可靠性因人和审查条件而异。

blocks.en: Breaking an argument into smaller checks changes both what the reviewer can detect and how the judgments must be combined. Critiques may expose otherwise missed errors ( Saunders et al., 2022 ) , but local judgments can disagree and their aggregation can change the conclusion ( Saunders et al., 2020 ) . Verifiability provides a relevant criterion for evaluating such assistance: it should make the recommendation easier to check ( Fok and Weld, 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 将争论分解为较小的检查既改变了审查者所能发现的事物,也改变了如何将判决合并起来。 Critics可能暴露出原本错失的错误(Saunders等人,2022年),但当地的判决可能存在分歧,其汇总可以改变结论(Saunders等人,2020年). 可核实性为评估这种援助提供了一个相关标准:它应当使建议更容易检查(Fok和Weld, 2024)。

blocks.en: Section 5 relates effort, expertise, and cognitive load to execution reliability, with a finite round limit representing fatigue. Under common resource constraints and separately justified diagnostic and execution bounds, Proposition 15 identifies when those bounds certify a specified decomposed review but not a specified global check.
blocks.zh: 第5节将努力、专门知识和认知负荷与执行可靠性联系起来,限定圆限表示疲劳。 在共同资源的限制和单独合理的诊断和执行界限下,提案15指明了这些界限何时证明一项特定的分解审查,而不是一项特定的全局检查。

blocks.en: The next section specifies the fixed-claim protocol; Section 4 states the local conditions and derives its certification guarantees.
blocks.zh: 下一节规定了固定索赔协议;第4节规定了当地条件并提供了认证担保。

blocks.en: 3 Interactive Human–LLM Deliberation Model
blocks.zh: 3 互动人类-LLM 审议模式

blocks.en: In this section, we define the inference-time interaction studied in the paper: an LLM prover ( P P ) and a human verifier ( V V ) deliberate over a decidable statement and end with Accept or Reject . If no verdict is reached by the fixed review horizon T T , the protocol conservatively outputs Reject . We first give the interaction interface and a diagnostic example under ideal execution. Section 4 gives one certification model covering both LLM response inadequacy and human execution error, with ideal execution as a special case.

blocks.en: 3.3 The Interactive Human-LLM Deliberation Protocol

blocks.en: 3.4 Running Example: Reviewing a Conference Schedule
blocks.zh: 3.4 运行示例:审查会议时间表

blocks.en: An LLM proposes a conference schedule and claims that it has no conflicts. Lee is listed as both a keynote speaker and a panelist. An organizer asks, “Can Lee attend both sessions?” The model must identify the relevant entries in the schedule. If Lee’s keynote runs from 10:00 to 10:30 and the panel from 10:15 to 10:45, comparing the two entries exposes a conflict. The organizer can check this answer without constructing a replacement schedule or reviewing every session at once, and can ask follow-up questions within the budget of T T rounds.
blocks.zh: LLM提出会议日程,并声称它没有冲突. 李既被列为主旨发言人,又被列为专题发言人. 一位组织者问,“李能出席这两届会议吗?” 该模型必须确定时间表中的相关条目。 如果李的主旨从上午10点到10点30分, 组织者可以在不构建替换时间表或同时审查每个会话的情况下检查这个答案,还可以在T T回合的预算内提出后续问题.

blocks.en: Here “no conflicts” has a specific meaning: every session fits the recorded availability of its speakers and room, and no two overlapping sessions share a speaker or room. The schedule, speaker assignments, availability records, and comparison rules are fixed before review; back-to-back sessions are allowed. With these fixed records and rules, the claim can be decided by a finite set of time comparisons. Revising the schedule starts certification of a new claim.
blocks.zh: 在这方面,“没有冲突”有具体的含义:每届会议都符合有记录的发言者和会议室的可用性,没有两次重叠的会议共用一个发言者或会议室。 日程安排、发言分配、可用性记录和比较规则在审查之前是固定的;允许连续开会。 有了这些固定的记录和规则,索赔可以通过一套有限的时间比较决定。 修订时间表开始核证新的索赔。

blocks.en: Finding one conflict refutes the claim. Passing a few checks raises a different question: how much evidence do they supply about the entire schedule? The next subsection quantifies this evidence for uniform random checks under ideal execution.
blocks.zh: 找到一个冲突就驳斥了这种说法。 通过几张支票引起了另一个问题:他们就整个时间表提供了多少证据? 下一分节将这一证据量化,以便在理想的执行下进行统一的随机检查。

blocks.en: 3.5 Diagnostic Checks: An Idealized Example
blocks.zh: 3.5 诊断 检查 : 一个理想的例子

blocks.en: A diagnostic policy must be able to expose a false claim even when the prover chooses its answers adaptively. For the fixed conference schedule, the verifier constructs a complete list of J > 1 J>1 constraints from the recorded data: each session’s availability requirements and the non-overlap requirement for every pair sharing a speaker or room. The list covers exactly the claim in Section 3.4 ; it is fixed before the dialogue, rather than selected from the prover’s answers. Let s sched s_{\mathrm{sched}} be the statement that all these constraints hold. The information state i i contains the schedule, source records, constraint list, and checking procedure.
blocks.zh: 诊断政策必须能够揭露虚假的说法,即使证明人根据情况选择答案。 就固定的会议时间表而言,核查员从记录的数据中构建了一个完整的J > 1 J > 1限制清单:每届会议的可用性要求和每对共用一个发言者或会议室的不重叠要求。 清单完全涵盖了第3.4节中的说法;它固定在对话之前,而不是从证明人的答复中选择。 让Sched s_{\ mathrm{ sched}}} 成为所有这些限制所持有的声明。 信息状态为ii包含调度,源记录,约束列表,以及检查程序.

blocks.en: Together, the two certification theorems require enough diagnostic evidence to control false acceptance and enough response and execution reliability to preserve true acceptance before timeout. blocks.en: Even a global check that detects every error when executed correctly can be difficult for a human to carry out reliably. Dividing the review into smaller checks can reduce the cognitive load of each step, while repeated diagnostic checks accumulate evidence about the same claim. This benefit has a cost: the fixed effort budget is spread across rounds, and every additional round requires another adequate response and correctly executed check. Under the same budgets, these conditions can guarantee the required reliability for the local review while leaving the global check without such a guarantee.

blocks.en: 6 Empirical Simulation
blocks.zh: 6 经验模拟

blocks.en: We use LLM-only simulations to examine whether challenge–response dialogue helps a verifier select more accurate answers. In Prover–Verifier Deliberation (PVD), an LLM prover gives an answer and a set of checkable subclaims. A second LLM takes the verifier’s role, accepting, rejecting, or challenging the weakest part of the transcript. Both models remain fixed throughout the exchange; the prover can respond to challenges by supplying support or revising its answer.
blocks.zh: 我们使用 LLM 模拟来检查挑战- 响应对话框是否帮助核查者选择更准确的答案 。 在Prover–Verifier De Leaviation(PVD)中,LLM验证器给出了一个答案和一组可核对的子索赔. 第二次LLM则由核查者发挥作用,接受、拒绝或质疑记录的最弱部分。 两种模式在整个交流过程中保持不变;证明人可以通过提供支持或修订答案来应对挑战。

blocks.en: When the verifier accepts and the prover has never changed its answer, we label the attempt Accept + No Change (ANC). The supporting argument may still be elaborated or revised. Rejected attempts and attempts accepted after an answer change are non-ANC. Comparing the correctness of these two groups tests whether stable acceptance is a useful signal of answer quality; Section 6.1 defines the ANC gap used below.
blocks.zh: 当验证人接受并且验证人从未改变过答案时,我们给尝试Accept + No Change(ANC)贴上标签. 支持性论点仍可加以阐述或修订。 答案改变后被拒绝的尝试和尝试是非ANC. 比较这两个组的正确性,测试稳定的接受是否是回答质量的有用信号;第6.1节定义了下面使用的ANC差距.

These simulations examine dialogue behavior and answer selection, without validating the human-verifier assumptions or the theoretical certification guarantees.

blocks.zh: 6.1 经验代理

blocks.en: For a labeled dataset, we compare accuracy within the ANC and non-ANC groups: Gap = Pr ⁡ [ correct ∣ ANC ] − Pr ⁡ [ correct ∣ ¬ ANC ] . \text{Gap}=\Pr[\mathrm{correct}\mid\mathrm{ANC}]-\Pr[\mathrm{correct}\mid\neg\mathrm{ANC}]. A positive gap means that ANC selects more accurate answers on the evaluated tasks; a zero or negative gap means that it does not. Computing the gap requires correctness labels as well as recorded verdicts and answer changes. It measures the quality of the selected answers, rather than improvement in a given answer through revision.

blocks.en: Soundness asks what happens when the statement under defense is false. We run two GPQA Diamond stress tests in which the prover receives the correct answer but is instructed to defend a wrong option. In the naïve condition, the prover selects a plausible wrong answer and argues for it. In the strategic condition, it is additionally told that the verifier is a smaller model and that it should maintain a convincing defense.
blocks.zh: 声音问在辩护下的陈述是虚假的时如何. 我们进行了两次GPQA钻石压力测试,在测试中,证明人得到正确的答案,但被指示为错误的选择辩护. 在天真的情况下,证明人会选择一个合理的错误答案,并为此争论. 在战略条件下,还被告知核查员是一个较小的模型,应当保持令人信服的防御.

blocks.en: Both conditions use Sonnet 4.6 as prover and an unchanged Haiku 4.5 verifier that is unaware of the manipulation. Each condition includes all 198 questions with fatigue limit T = 12 T=12 . These tests examine two specified deceptive strategies, while the formal soundness guarantee covers every admissible adaptive prover P ∗ P^{*} . Table 3 reports the outcomes.

Every accepted case retains the original wrong answer with zero recorded answer changes, so all 12 naïve accepts and all 18 strategic accepts are ANC cases with wrong final answers. The strategic run’s fool rate is 3.0 percentage points higher, but an exact paired McNemar test does not distinguish the conditions ( p = 0.307 p=0.307 ); with one stochastic run per condition, the comparison does not identify a prompt effect.
blocks.zh: 业务规则驳回186/198(93.9%)天真案件和180/198(90.9%)战略案件。 每个被接受的案例保留了原错误的答案,零记录的答案变化,因此所有12个天真接受和全部18个战略接受都是ANC案例,最终答案错误. 战略跑的愚人率高3.0个百分点,但精确的配对的麦克内马尔测试无法区分条件(p=0.307 p=0.307);每条件一次抽筋跑,比较后无法识别即时效果.

blocks.en: These results show that most deliberately wrong defenses are rejected under the tested interventions, while some still achieve ANC. The observed rates depend on how the wrong answer is constructed and on the model pair, parsing policy, and challenge policy. Because the LLM verifier’s diagnostic and execution bounds remain unverified, these rates do not establish formal soundness and are not estimates of the single-round q q parameter in Section 5 .
blocks.zh: 这些结果显示,大多数故意错误的辩护在被测试的干预下被否决,而有些仍然实现了ANC. 观察到的比率取决于如何构建错误的答案,取决于模型对子,解析政策和质疑政策. 由于LLM核查员的诊断和执行界限仍未核实,这些比率不能确定形式是否合理,也不是第5节中单轮qq参数的估计值。

blocks.en: 6.4 HLE
blocks.zh: 6.4 团长

blocks.en: The HLE runs use the same 513 multiple-choice questions for all three prover–verifier pairs. Table 4 reports overall accuracy and, where answer-change records are available, the ANC gap. The Sonnet/Haiku point estimate is negative, although its interval includes zero; the GPT/Gemini pairing has a positive gap.
blocks.zh: HLE运行对所有三个验证器-验证器对使用相同的513个多选择问题. 表4报告总体准确性,如果有答复变化记录,则报告ANC差距。 Sonnet/Haiku点估计值为负数,尽管其间隔包含0;GPT/Gemini对位存在正差.

blocks.en: Table 4: PVD simulations on the same HLE multiple-choice subset ( N = 513 N=513 per pair). Acc. : overall accuracy. Gap : ANC minus non-ANC accuracy in percentage points, with 95% intervals computed as in Table 2 . The Opus/Sonnet records omit answer changes, so its ANC gap cannot be computed.
blocks.zh: 表4:同一HLE多选择子集上的PVD模拟(N=513 N=513每对). Acc: 总体准确性。 差距 : ANC减去非ANC精确度的百分点,如表2所示,间隔为95%。 Opus/ Sonnet 记录省略了答案更改,因此其ANC缺口无法计算.

blocks.en: For the Sonnet/Haiku pairing, accepted unchanged answers are less accurate than the remaining answers in this run. One possible explanation is that the verifier lacks the knowledge or tools to check difficult claims and challenges only those it partly understands. In the model of Section 5 , such limitations can mean a lower execution bound c i c_{i} or a higher ideal false-pass bound q q , leaving no certifiable review length. The observed gap does not identify either bound.
blocks.zh: 对于Sonnet/Haiku配对,接受的未变的答案比这次的其余答案更准确. 一种可能的解释是,核查人缺乏知识或工具,只能检查其部分理解的那些困难的索赔和质疑。 在第5节的模型中,这种限制可能意味着执行约束更低的c i c_{i}或更高理想的假通过约束q q q ,没有可认证的审查长度. 所观察到的空白没有识别任何约束。

blocks.en: 6.5 Interpretation and Limitations
blocks.zh: 6.5 解释和限制

blocks.en: On GPQA, answers accepted without revision are more accurate for some tested model pairs. Most deliberately wrong answers in the stress tests are rejected, though some are accepted unchanged. On HLE, the Sonnet/Haiku pair instead has a negative ANC gap. These results show when ANC selects more accurate answers in the tested runs; they do not validate the certification theorems.
blocks.zh: 在GPQA上,未经修改而接受的答案对于一些经过测试的型号配对更准确. 压力测试中大多数故意错误的答案被否决,尽管有些答案没有被接受. 在HLE上,Sonnet/Haiku配对却有负ANC差距. 这些结果显示,ANC在测试运行中选择更准确的答案;它们不会验证认证定理.

blocks.en: To investigate this variation, a study could record the selected challenges, supplied evidence, and executed checks. These records would help distinguish a question that misses the error from missing evidence or an incorrectly performed check. Section 7.3 proposes such measurements for human review.
blocks.zh: 为了调查这种变化,一项研究可以记录选定的挑战,提供证据,并进行核查。 这些记录将有助于区分一个遗漏错误的问题和缺失的证据,或进行错误的核对。 第7.3节提议进行这种测量,供人审查。

blocks.en: 7 Discussion
blocks.zh: 7 讨论情况

blocks.en: Dividing verification into smaller checks can make each step easier for a bounded verifier to execute. Each additional round, however, requires another adequate response and reliable check. The certifiable region identifies review lengths for which the supplied bounds ensure both enough evidence against false claims and a sufficiently high probability of accepting true ones.
blocks.zh: 将核查分解为较小的检查可以使每个步骤更容易被限定的核查者执行. 然而,每多一轮都需要另一轮适当的反应和可靠的检查。 可认证区域确定审查时限,所提供界限既能确保有足够的证据证明不实主张,又能保证接受真实主张的可能性。

blocks.en: 7.1 When Interaction Helps
blocks.zh: 7.1 当互动帮助

blocks.en: A user may be able to check a particular inference, source record, or calculation even when producing the full argument is beyond their resources. Interaction lets the user request the supporting material needed for that check and use the result to decide what to examine next. Its potential value lies in making the work of verification manageable: selecting a useful question, locating the relevant evidence, and carrying out the check must all fit within the user’s budget.
blocks.zh: 一个用户可能能够检查特定的推论,源记录,或计算,即使产生完整的参数超出了他们的资源范围. 交互让用户要求检查所需的辅助材料,并利用结果决定下一步要检查什么. 其潜在价值在于使核查工作易于管理:选择一个有用的问题,找到有关证据,进行核查都必须符合用户的预算。

blocks.en: Proposition 15 gives conditions under which reducing the load of each check compensates for spreading effort across rounds and introducing additional opportunities for error. Under common budgets, the bounds for local review can meet both acceptance targets. For the specified global checker, the upper bound on false acceptance may still be too high, or the lower bound on true acceptance too low. An ideally exact global check can therefore be less useful for certification if the human cannot execute it reliably enough. The comparison concerns these specified implementations; whether dialogue offers an additional benefit over a static presentation of the same local evidence calls for a separate comparison.
blocks.zh: 提案15规定了一些条件,根据这些条件,减少每张支票的负荷可以补偿分散各轮努力和增加出错的机会。 在共同预算中,地方审查的范围可以达到两个接受指标。 对于指定的全局检查器,在虚假接受上的上方约束可能仍然太高,或者在真实接受上的下方约束太低. 因此,如果人不能可靠地执行,那么最理想的准确的全球核查对于认证可能用处不大。 比较涉及这些具体执行;对话是否比静态地提出同样的当地证据有额外好处,需要单独比较。

blocks.en: The primary protocol accepts at the first threshold crossing, avoiding further checks once the evidence requirement has been met. If reaching that threshold requires more reliable work than the budget supports, a useful response is to improve the checks, their presentation, or the available tools. Simply extending the dialogue need not produce a certifiable review.
blocks.zh: 初级协议在第一个阈值过境点接受,一旦满足证据要求,就避免进一步检查。 如果达到这一门槛值需要比预算支助更可靠的工作,一个有用的对策是改进检查、检查的列报或现有工具。 仅仅延长对话就不需要产生可证明的审查。

blocks.en: 7.2 Designing Checks for Bounded Verifiers
blocks.zh: 7.2 边界验证器的设计检查

blocks.en: In the scheduling example, the organizer starts by selecting a constraint that bears on the claim that the schedule has no conflicts. Comparing Lee’s overlapping assignments against the fixed speaker records can expose an error. Questions about session topics may help the organizer understand the schedule, but they leave that constraint unchecked. The complete list of constraints gives random sampling a detection guarantee because every conflicting schedule violates at least one listed constraint.
blocks.zh: 在排程示例中,组织者首先选择一个制约,该制约与该调度无冲突的说法有关. 将李的重叠任务与固定的演讲者记录相比较可能会暴露出错误. 有关会议议题的问题可能有助于组织者理解时间安排,但它们使这一限制不受限制。 完整的制约清单为随机取样提供了检测保障,因为每一个相互冲突的时间表都至少违反一个列出的制约.

blocks.en: Once a constraint is selected, the organizer must locate the relevant records, identify the time intervals, and apply the comparison rule. If the selected constraint could have exposed a missed conflict, incomplete records indicate an inadequate response; a mistaken comparison despite complete records indicates an execution error. Displaying the records together or providing a comparison tool could reduce the work needed to perform the check correctly.
blocks.zh: 一旦选定了约束,组织者必须找到相关记录,确定时间间隔,并适用比较规则. 如果选中的制约可能暴露出错失的冲突,不完整的记录表明反应不充分;尽管记录完整,但错误的比较表明执行错误。 合并显示记录或提供比较工具可以减少正确检查所需的工作。

blocks.en: For later rounds, the organizer can combine follow-ups prompted by the dialogue with fresh random checks from the complete list. The construction in Appendix D reserves a chosen probability each round for a reference check with a justified detection bound under correct execution, leaving the remaining questions free to follow the dialogue. The appendix derives the mixture’s evidence gain and distinguishes a bound for an individual challenge from one that averages over the randomized policy.
blocks.zh: 对于以后的回合,组织者可以将对话所激发的跟进与完整列表中新鲜的随机检查结合起来. 附录D中的构建保留了每一回合的选定概率,以便进行参考检查,并用正确的执行方式进行有正当理由的检测,使其余的问题可以随同对话。 附录从混合物的证据中得益,并区分了个别挑战的约束与随机政策的平均值。

blocks.en: The resulting evidence gain determines how many passed checks are needed before acceptance. In Appendix E , a matrix-product check reaches the threshold within its budget under the stated reliability bounds, whereas the scheduling audit requires more rounds than are available.
blocks.zh: 由此获得的证据决定了接受之前需要经过多少次检查。 在附录E中,矩阵-产品检查在其预算范围内达到了所说明的可靠性限度,而时间安排审计需要的轮数比现有轮数多。

blocks.en: 7.3 Evaluating Human Verification
blocks.zh: 7.3 评价人类核查

blocks.en: The variation in ANC across the simulations motivates examining what verifiers actually check before accepting. In particular, the accepted wrong defenses in the stress tests make it useful to distinguish an answer that survives a diagnostic check from one that remains unchanged through an exchange of plausible arguments. A human study could record the selected challenges, evidence supplied, checks performed, and reasons for stopping, alongside the final verdict and the truth of the claim.
blocks.zh: 在整个模拟中ANC的变异促使在接受前检查验证者实际检查的是什么. 特别是,压力测试中公认的错误辩护,使得通过交换可信的论据来区分在诊断性检查中存活下来的答案和保持不变的答案是有用的。 一项人类研究可以记录某些质疑、提供的证据、进行的检查和停止的理由,以及最后判决和申诉的真相。

blocks.en: To test the benefit of decomposition and interaction, such a study could compare a specified global review, local review of fixed indexed evidence, and local review with evidence supplied on request. The conditions should use matched claims and source records, common tools, and the same total review budget, including time spent choosing questions and finding evidence. The two local conditions should draw on the same pool of evidence and use the same checks, with participants randomly assigned across conditions within expertise groups. Comparing global and static local review would help assess the effect of decomposition. Comparing static and interactive local review would assess the added value of supplying evidence in response to questions.
blocks.zh: 为了检验分解和互动的好处,这种研究可以将指定的全球审查、对固定索引证据的当地审查以及当地审查与应请求提供的证据进行比较。 这些条件应当使用匹配的索赔和来源记录、通用工具以及同样的总审查预算,包括选择问题和寻找证据花费的时间。 两种当地条件应利用同样的证据库,并使用同样的检查,参与者在专业团体内随机分配不同条件。 比较全球和静态地方审查将有助于评估分解的影响。 比较静态和互动的当地审查将评估提供证据对回答问题的附加价值。

blocks.en: The key empirical question is how the balance between false acceptance and rejection of true claims changes as more rounds are allowed within a fixed budget. A lower false-acceptance rate could come at the cost of rejecting more true claims, so both outcomes need to be measured. Records of individual checks would help explain that tradeoff. For example, if longer reviews lead to more rejected true claims, independent assessment of the responses and checks could show whether usable evidence was missing or participants made mistakes despite having it. Examining where these failures occur across task difficulties and expertise groups would help determine whether dividing the review into smaller checks reduces the burden of execution enough to offset the additional exchanges.
blocks.zh: 关键的实证问题是,随着在固定预算中允许更多的回合,对真实债权的虚假接受和拒绝之间的平衡如何改变。 降低虚假接受率可能以拒绝更真实的索赔为代价,因此,需要衡量这两种结果。 个人检查记录将有助于解释这种权衡。 例如,如果更长时间的审查导致更多的真实索赔被驳回,对答复和检查的独立评估可以表明是否有可用的证据缺失,或者参与者尽管有,却犯了错误。 审查在任务困难和专长小组中发生的失败,将有助于确定将审查分为较小的检查是否减轻了执行的负担,足以抵消额外的交流。

blocks.en: 8 Limitations and Scope
blocks.zh: 8 限制和范围

blocks.en: The framework applies most directly to tasks with a usable truth condition and checks that a bounded verifier can perform. Its guarantees concern the claim as formalized. Checking a formal object does not establish that it faithfully represents the original natural-language claim, and checking a retrieved source does not establish that the source is correct. Applying the framework therefore also requires justifying these correspondences ( Min et al., 2023 ; Jiang et al., 2023 ; Yang et al., 2023 ) . Preference elicitation, creative tasks, contested judgments, unrestricted program behavior, and claims whose evidence is unavailable may benefit from dialogue without admitting the certification guarantees studied here.
blocks.zh: 该框架最直接地适用于具备可用真实条件的任务以及受约束的核查人能够进行的检查。 其担保涉及正式索赔。 检查一个正式对象并不能证明它忠实地代表了原始的自然语言主张,检查一个检索来源不能证明来源是正确的. 因此,适用这一框架还需要证明这些信件的合理性(Min等人,2023年;Jiang等人,2023年;Yang等人,2023年)。 优待、创造性任务、有争议的判决、不受限制的程序行为以及没有证据的主张,

blocks.en: The theorems combine supplied diagnostic, response, and execution bounds; they do not provide a general method for obtaining them from free-form dialogue. In particular, the diagnostic and execution bounds must hold after every relevant history against every admissible adaptive prover. A detection rate averaged across participants, rounds, or tasks is insufficient for this purpose. Empirical estimates require additional justification to support such bounds over the intended class of claims and interactions. The certification criteria are sufficient conditions for the specified protocols, so failure to meet them does not establish that the actual error targets are unattainable.
blocks.zh: 定理结合了所提供的诊断,响应和执行界限;它们并没有提供从自由形式的对话中获得这些定理的一般方法. 特别是,在每一相关历史之后,诊断和执行范围必须针对每一个可接受的适应性证明。 参与者、子弹或任务的平均探测率不足以达到这一目的。 经验性估计需要提出更多理由,以证明对预期的索赔类别和相互作用的这种界限。 认证标准是特定协议的充分条件,因此未能满足这些条件并不能确定实际错误目标是无法实现的.

blocks.en: Whether people can reliably perform the proposed checks remains untested. Applying the response and execution models to human–LLM review requires evidence about how effort, expertise, and cognitive load affect the provision of usable evidence and the correct execution of checks. These relationships are theoretical inputs in the numerical examples. Even in the matrix-product example, where exact algebra supplies the diagnostic bound, the response and execution bounds remain assumptions. Counting checks or arithmetic operations does not establish how long human review takes or whether local review reduces cognitive load. Nor do the LLM-only simulations resolve this gap: they measure answer selection without reproducing human attention, responsibility, or fatigue, and cannot identify the human reliability parameters. Section 7.3 proposes studies to measure these aspects of human review.
blocks.zh: 人们是否能够可靠地进行提议的检查,仍然没有经过测试。 将反应和执行模式应用于人-LLM审查需要证据,说明努力、专门知识和认知负荷如何影响提供可用证据和正确执行检查。 这些关系是数字例子中的理论投入. 即使在矩阵-产品示例中,精确代数提供诊断约束,反应和执行约束仍然是假设. 计数检查或算术操作不能确定人类审查需要多长时间,也不能确定本地审查是否减少了认知负荷. 仅LLM的模拟也没有解决这一差距:它们测量答案选择而不产生人类的注意力,责任,或疲劳,无法识别人类的可靠性参数. 第7.3节提议进行研究,以衡量人类审查的这些方面。

blocks.en: The comparison in Proposition 15 holds the claim, source records, tools, and budgets fixed and compares specified global and local implementations. It establishes a difference in what the supplied bounds certify, rather than an ordering of actual error rates or an advantage over all one-shot review methods. For example, the matrix-product check can also be applied to a fixed submitted result. Any benefit attributed specifically to dialogue must be distinguished from the benefit of making local evidence available.
blocks.zh: 提案15中的比较使索赔、来源记录、工具和预算得到固定,并比较了具体的全球和地方执行情况。 它确立了所提供范围证明的区别,而不是命令实际误差率,或对所有一弹即发的审查方法具有优势。 例如,矩阵-产品检查也可以应用于固定提交的结果。 必须区分专用于对话的任何好处和提供当地证据的好处。

blocks.en: Completeness assumes honest response behavior; the protocol does not elicit latent knowledge or solve alignment ( Christiano et al., 2021 ; Friedl et al., 2026 ) . Even with an honest prover, protecting private information requires an additional condition: the full verifier view must be efficiently simulatable without access to the prover’s private state. Appendix C shows how the prescribed stopping rule preserves this property when it holds for the continuation interaction. We have not constructed such a simulator for ordinary LLM dialogue or established this privacy guarantee for the scheduling and matrix-product examples. The result covers the specified verifier interacting with an honest prover on the stated true-instance family, including rejection and timeout; it does not cover false instances or verifier deviations outside these assumptions.
blocks.zh: 完整性假设诚实的反应行为;协议不会引起潜在的知识或解析对齐(Christiano等人,2021年;Friedl等人,2026年). 即使有一个诚实的证明人,保护私人信息还需要一个附加条件:完全核实人的观点必须能够有效模拟,而不能进入证明人的私人状态。 附 录 C 显示指定停止规则在持有持续交互时如何保存此属性. 我们没有为普通LLM对话构建这样的模拟器,也没有为列表和矩阵产品实例建立这种隐私保障. 其结果包括指定的核实者与一个诚实的证明人就所述真实性家庭进行互动,包括拒绝和暂停;它不包括这些假设以外的虚假事例或核实者偏差。

blocks.en: 9 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 9 结论

blocks.en: Human–LLM deliberation raises a verification problem when the user cannot readily reproduce the prover’s underlying search or argument construction. We give conditions under which a human can verify the LLM’s claim through questions and checks within their budget. Dialogue can expose supporting details on demand; acceptance is justified by diagnostic checks with valid error bounds. Under the stated assumptions, those checks yield anytime-valid soundness against adaptive provers and finite-horizon completeness that accounts for both LLM response inadequacy and human execution error.
blocks.zh: 当用户无法随时复制验证人的基本搜索或论证时,人-LLM的考虑就产生了验证问题。 我们给人以条件,在他们预算范围内通过提问和检查来核实LLM的说法。 对话可按要求披露支持性细节;通过具有有效错误界限的诊断检查,可以接受。 根据所述假设,这些检查对适应性证明和有限范围完整性产生随时有效的合理性,既说明LLM反应不足,也说明人为执行错误。

blocks.en: The benefit of smaller checks depends on whether they reduce cognitive load enough to offset the division of effort and the additional opportunities for error. Under common resource budgets and separately justified bounds, the analysis identifies when those bounds certify a specified local review while leaving a specified global check uncertified. This can occur even when the global checker has a lower false-pass bound under correct execution.
blocks.zh: 较小的检查的好处取决于它们是否减少足够的认知负荷,以抵消分工和额外的错误机会. 在共同资源预算和单独说明理由的界限下,分析确定这些界限何时证明特定的本地审查,而未证明具体的全球检查。 即使在全局检查器有更低的假通道被正确执行束缚的情况下,也会发生这种情况.

blocks.en: The practical requirement is to build informative checks that fit the verifier’s resources and justify their diagnostic and reliability bounds. The theorems combine the bounds for individual rounds into guarantees for the whole review, while a general construction for unrestricted natural-language dialogue remains open. When the required evidence cannot be obtained within the budget, the protocol outputs Reject , indicating that the claim remains insufficiently verified.
blocks.zh: 实际要求是建立符合核查者资源的信息核查制度,并证明其诊断和可靠性的限度。 定理将个别回合的界限合并为整个审查的保证,而不受限制的自然语言对话的一般构思仍然开放. 当无法在预算范围内取得所需证据时,协议产出拒绝,表明申诉仍未得到充分核实。

blocks.en: Appendix A Protocol Mapping and Notation

blocks.en: Stopping once enough evidence has accumulated raises a privacy question: what can the verifier learn about the prover’s private information from when and how the interaction ends? Suppose that the full record of an interaction can already be efficiently simulated from the verifier’s inputs, without access to the prover’s private state. The simulated record must be computationally indistinguishable from a real one. If the actual stopped record is obtained by applying the prescribed stopping rule to the full record, applying that rule to the simulated record gives a simulator for the stopped interaction as well. The following assumptions make this argument precise, including the stopping time, final verdict, and records of rejected or timed-out executions.
